units.source_text: 尽管是洁白的小脚，可是爱好登山的岛村，

en.t: Though his feet were small and white, Shimamura, who loved mountain climbing,

units.source_text: 一边走着一边欣赏山景，心情不由地变得茫然若失，

en.t: as he walked along enjoying the mountain scenery, his mind involuntarily grew dazed and lost,

units.source_text: 不知不觉间脚步也就加快了。

en.t: and before he knew it, his steps had quickened too.

units.source_text: 对经常容易突然迷离恍惚的他来说，

en.t: For him, who was always prone to slip suddenly into a vague trance,

units.source_text: 不能相信那面映着黄昏景致和早晨雪景的镜子是人工制造的。

en.t: he could not believe that the mirror reflecting the evening scene and the morning snow scene was something made by human hands.
It was something that belonged to nature.

units.source_text: 而且是属于遥远的世界。

en.t: And it belonged to a distant world.
